features.label: Features
features.intro: A solution designed for Belgian SMEs that want to be compliant without complicating their lives.

items.title: Clock in with 1 tap
items.description: IN / OUT in a single gesture. Works on smartphone, tablet and PC with no training.

items.title: Compliant with 2027 law
items.description: Objective recording, immutable audit trail and certified export. Ready for legal inspection.

items.title: Kiosk, QR & Mobile
items.description: 4 methods: mobile app (PWA), tablet kiosk, printable QR code per site (1 scan = instant clock-in) or web interface. Zero installation.

items.title: Smart alerts
items.description: End-of-day reminder, overtime detection, real-time notifications.

items.title: Zero GPS · GDPR
items.description: No geolocation (CBA 68 · GDPR). CSV and PDF exports digitally signed for legal inspection.

items.title: Team management
items.description: Managers, sites, leave, time-off recovery — all centralised for HR and administrators.

methods.label: How to clock in
methods.intro: Every team is different. Pointon adapts to your reality.

items.title: Mobile PWA
items.description: Arrival and departure in 1 tap from any smartphone. No installation.

items.title: Tablet kiosk
items.description: 4-digit PIN at the office entrance. Ideal for fixed on-site teams.

items.title: QR Code
items.description: 1 QR per site. 1 scan = 1 instant clock-in. Printable, tamper-proof.

items.title: Web interface
items.description: From any PC and browser. Same experience, same simplicity.

methods.kioskSubDetail: Reception, time-stamped badge and tracking of external visits — without a Pointon account.

items.quote: We used to write hours on paper. Now it’s automatic. My employees clock in on the tablet at the entrance, I export the summary on Friday. Setup: 10 minutes.

My technicians are rarely in the office. With the tablet kiosk at the depot and the mobile app for travel, everyone clocks in easily.

items.q: What happens if I clock in offline?
items.a: Your clock-in is saved locally and marked "⏳ pending sync". On reconnection, it automatically syncs to the server and becomes official. The presence board only counts synced clock-ins.

overtimeInfo.subtitle: Understand the overtime system
overtimeInfo.step1Body: When you work more than your configured hours (e.g. 8h), overtime is automatically detected by the system.
overtimeInfo.step2Body: The administrator sees this overtime in their dashboard and approves or rejects it.
overtimeInfo.step3Body: Once approved, you can use these hours in 2 ways (see opposite).
overtimeInfo.way2Body: Leave earlier thanks to your overtime (1h = leave 1h earlier)
overtimeInfo.a1: Yes! It is calculated automatically when you clock out at the end of the day.
overtimeInfo.q2: Q: What if the admin rejects it?
overtimeInfo.a2: It does not count in your balance. The admin can add a reason for the rejection.
overtimeInfo.q3: Q: Can I combine both approaches?
overtimeInfo.a3: Yes! For example: 16h overtime = 1 day off (8h) + 8h recovery.

schedules.title: Work schedules
schedules.subtitle: Assign a schedule template to each employee. Create your own models or use the Belgian presets.
schedules.rotationNote: ↻ Employees in a team with a rotation cycle don’t need a fixed schedule — the rotation automatically determines their shifts in the planning.
schedules.descJOURNEE: Classic office hours, no rotation. E.g. 9am-5pm, Mon-Fri.
schedules.desc2X8: Discontinuous — 2 teams alternate morning/afternoon. No night. E.g. 6am-2pm / 2pm-10pm.
schedules.desc3X8: Semi-continuous — 3 teams cover 24h on weekdays. Weekends off. Common in Belgian industry.
schedules.desc4X8: Continuous — 4 teams rotating 24/7, weekends included. Avg. 42h/week. E.g. refining, chemicals.
schedules.desc5X8: Continuous 24/7 — 5 teams, avg. 38h/week. Energy, steel, petrochemical sectors.
schedules.desc2X12: 12h shifts — 2 teams day/night. Common in hospitals, security, emergency services.
schedules.descNUIT: Fixed night shift (10pm-6am). Belgian legal compensation required (CBA no. 49).
schedules.descPARTIEL: Part-time — hours and days to be defined by the contract.
schedules.descVARIABLE: Fixed blocks with flexible arrival. E.g. fixed block 9am-3pm, flexible 7-9am / 3-7pm.
schedules.rotationBadgeTitle: The team’s rotation cycle takes precedence over this schedule for automatic planning
